descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# The most realistic golf swing in VR. High Precision Control (HPC©) captures every shot with millimetric accuracy; real physics, not arcade. Try free for 30 minutes!

Developed with **The R&A, Me and My Golf** and **DP World Tour**, Golf 5 delivers iconic courses in ultra‑realistic HD. Play solo, vs AI or online with friends worldwide. Earn G5 coins, compete in tournaments, and climb the International eGolf Federation ranking.

✅ **Why Golf 5**

• Real shot physics and precise shot feedback
• Stunning graphics and iconic courses
• No subscription needed to play
• For all levels, from beginners to serious golfers; real handicap calculation

🏌🏻 **Authentic Golf**

• Online or offline: solo or vs AI 🌐
• 9 or 18 Holes, plus Flash 3 Holes fast matches ⚡
• Team‑based online play: Scramble and Fourball 🤝
• Scoring formats: Match, Stroke or Stableford 🏆

⛳ **Courses**

• Visually striking courses
• 4 free: Dunes, Forest, Tropical; Safari unlocked by registering 🌴
• 8 premium: Royal County Down, Hoylake, Royal Troon, Birkdale, Royal Portrush, Old Course St Andrews, Sunningdale and Valderrama. More to come 🏛️
• All courses include Drone View, Dynamic Wind and Practice Anywhere™ 🍃

🎯 **Also Includes**

• WiPp: innovative fast mode ⏱️
• Driving Range 🏌️‍♀️
• Putting Green 🎯
• Minigolf 🌀
• Pro-level shot analysis powered by Xti© Pro Launch Manager 📈
• 2 free Callaway sets + 3 extras 🛒
• Instant presets for VR golf club grips 🎮
• Multilingual 🌍
• 3D Avatars, Mobile App... 👥

**Get ready for the most realistic and thrilling golf in VR.**
